message.content: Read the single-file browser game at /config/workspace/games/zelena-imperija/zelena-imperija.html. It is a FarmVille-style cannabis-growing tycoon game. Design spec: /config/workspace/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-02-zelena-imperija-design.md. All player-facing text is Macedonian Cyrillic; all code identifiers are Latin-transliterated Macedonian (zasadiSemka, parichnik, presmetajKvalitet). This is deliberate — do NOT report the Macedonian naming or the Macedonian UI as a problem, and do not suggest renaming to English. It must stay ONE self-contained file with no external assets, no build step, no network calls — do NOT suggest splitting it into modules, adding a bundler, or adding dependencies. Report ONLY concrete defects you can point at in the actual code. No speculation, no style preferences, no "consider adding tests". If you find nothing real in your lens, return an empty list. You are an adversarial verifier. Below are candidate findings from a "makedonski" review of that same file. Your job is to REFUTE each one by reading the actual code. Default to refuted: mark real=false unless you can point to the exact line(s) proving the defect is genuine and reachable in normal play. Reject anything that is a style preference, a restatement of an intentional design decision documented in the spec, a suggestion to add dependencies or split the file, or a complaint about the Macedonian naming convention. For findings you confirm, restate a minimal concrete fix and a precise "location" string that uniquely identifies where to apply it. CANDIDATE FINDINGS: [ { "title": "Mismatched quotation marks in the drying-complete toast (Macedonian opening „ closed with ASCII \")", "severity": "medium", "location": "sushenjeGotovo:(g,o)=>`Сушењето заврши: ${g} г, оценка „${o}\".`", "problem": "The string opens the grade name with the correct Macedonian low opening quote „ but closes it with a straight ASCII double quote (U+0022). Macedonian typography requires „…“ (U+201E … U+201C). This is the only place in the player-facing text where a non-Cyrillic/non-Macedonian typographic character leaks into a Macedonian sentence, and it renders as a visibly lopsided quote pair.", "failure_scenario": "Player harvests a plant, opens the Сушара tab and presses „Заврши сушење“. The toast reads: Сушењето заврши: 62 г, оценка „Одличен\". The closing quote is the wrong glyph and sits at a different height/shape than the opening one.", "fix": "Change the template literal to use the proper closing quote: `Сушењето заврши: ${g} г, оценка „${o}“.` (escape the backtick-safe string; the ASCII \" becomes “ U+201C)." }, { "title": "Singular/plural agreement broken: \"Имаш 1 семки\" in the shop panel", "severity": "medium", "location": "panelProdavnica: ${imam ? ` · Имаш ${imam} семки` : \"\"}", "problem": "The word „семки“ is hard-coded in the plural. In Macedonian the counted noun after 1 must be singular: „1 семка“, not „1 семки“. Every count of exactly one displays ungrammatically.", "failure_scenario": "A brand-new game starts with `semki: {skopsko: 1}` (novaIgra). The player opens Продавница on the very first screen and the Скопско Зелено card reads „· Имаш 1 семки“. Same happens any time a stock drops to or is bought up to exactly one.", "fix": "Pluralize conditionally: ` · Имаш ${imam} ${imam === 1 ? \"семка\" : \"семки\"}` (and apply the same rule anywhere else a seed count is printed)." }, { "title": "Nitrogen-deficiency button says the opposite of what the action does: „Ѓубри против азот“", "severity": "medium", "location": "``", "problem": "The event is „Недостаток на азот“ (nitrogen DEFICIENCY) and the cure is to add nitrogen via ѓубрење. „Ѓубри против азот“ literally means \"fertilize against nitrogen\", i.e. fertilize to get rid of nitrogen — the reverse of the game mechanic and of what a Macedonian grower would ever say. The preposition „против“ is copied from the pest buttons (акарицид/фунгицид против штетник), where it makes sense, and pasted onto a deficiency, where it does not.", "failure_scenario": "A plant contracts the `azot` event. The red action button appears reading „Ѓубри против азот“. The player reads it as \"fertilizer that removes nitrogen\" and is confused about why feeding the plant (nahrani) fixes a nitrogen problem — the button text contradicts TEKST.samoGubrenje („Ова се лекува со ѓубрење…“).", "fix": "Replace the caption with „Ѓубри со азот“ or „Додај азот“ (or „Наѓубри — недостаток на азот“), so the label states that nitrogen is being supplied, not removed." }, { "title": "Missing definite article: „Оди во сушара.“", "severity": "low", "location": "berba:(g,s)=>`Берба на ${s}: ${g} г мокра маса. Оди во сушара.`", "problem": "Macedonian marks a known, specific location with the postposed definite article. The player's drying room is a specific, unique facility already referred to elsewhere in the game as „Сушарата е празна“ and the tab „Сушара“. Bare „во сушара“ reads as \"into some drying room\" and is ungrammatical for the intended reference.", "failure_scenario": "Player presses „🌾 Обери“. Toast: „Берба на Вардар Куш: 386 г мокра маса. Оди во сушара.“ A native reader stumbles on the missing article; the sentence sounds like machine translation.", "fix": "Change to „Оди во сушарата.“" }, { "title": "„г мокро“ is not grammatical and contradicts „г мокра маса“ used elsewhere", "severity": "low", "location": "panelSushara: ${Math.round(s.gramaVlazno)} г мокро", "problem": "„мокро“ is a bare neuter adjective/adverb with no noun to agree with — „386 г мокро“ has nothing for „мокро“ to modify (грам is masculine). The same quantity is described correctly two functions earlier as „г мокра маса“. Growers in Macedonian say „свежа маса“ or „мокра маса“, never a dangling „мокро“.", "failure_scenario": "Player opens the Сушара tab. The batch header shows „386 г мокро“ while the harvest toast that produced it said „386 г мокра маса“ — two different, one ungrammatical, labels for the same number.", "fix": "Use the same phrase in both places: „${Math.round(s.gramaVlazno)} г мокра маса“ (or „свежа маса“ if you prefer the standard horticultural term)." }, { "title": "Latin script inside a Cyrillic UI: lamp named „ЛЕД Full-Spectrum“", "severity": "low", "location": "{id:\"leds\", ime:\"ЛЕД Full-Spectrum\", cena:2400000, ...}", "problem": "Every other lamp name is transliterated („Флуо“, „ХПС“, „ЛЕД“) but this one half-transliterates and then drops raw English Latin text into the Macedonian string. It is displayed both in the HUD („Ламба“ stat) and in the Надградби panel, so untransliterated Latin appears next to Cyrillic on screen.", "failure_scenario": "Player reaches level 9 and buys the top lamp. The HUD stat under „Ламба“ now reads „ЛЕД Full-Spectrum“, mixing scripts in a 4-character-wide stat box on an otherwise all-Cyrillic page.", "fix": "Rename to „ЛЕД со полн спектар“ (or „ЛЕД полн спектар“), matching the transliteration convention of the other three lamps." }, { "title": "„Вработен работник“ is a pleonasm", "severity": "low", "location": "{id:\"rabotnik\", ime:\"Вработен работник\", cena:900000, ...}", "problem": "In Macedonian „вработен“ already denotes an employed person (a noun in its own right), so „вработен работник“ says \"an employed worker\" — redundant and stilted. A native would name this upgrade „Вработен“, „Работник“ or „Најмен работник“.", "failure_scenario": "Player opens the Надградби tab and reads the upgrade card title „Вработен работник“, which reads as a translation artifact rather than natural Macedonian.", "fix": "Rename to „Најмен работник“ (or simply „Работник“)." }, { "title": "„идеалниот прозорец“ is an English calque for a time window", "severity": "low", "location": "opis:\"Сушењето е 40% побрзо, а идеалниот прозорец се шири на 8–14 дена.\"", "problem": "„Прозорец“ in Macedonian means a window in a wall or a GUI window; it is not used for a time interval. \"Ideal window\" is a direct calque from English. A Macedonian grower would say „идеалниот период“ or „идеалниот интервал“.", "failure_scenario": "Player reads the Професионална сушара upgrade description in the Надградби tab and parses „идеалниот прозорец се шири на 8–14 дена“ as something about a physical window on the drying shed.", "fix": "Rewrite as „…а идеалниот период се проширува на 8–14 дена.“" }, { "title": "„шансата за штетници“ — wrong register; „шанса“ implies a desirable outcome", "severity": "low", "location": "opis:\"Ја намалува шансата за штетници за 60%.\"", "problem": "In Macedonian „шанса“ carries a positive connotation (an opportunity, a chance to succeed). For an undesirable event one uses „веројатност“ or „ризик“. „Шансата за штетници“ reads as \"the opportunity for pests\", which is the wrong sense.", "failure_scenario": "Player reads the Клима-систем card in Надградби: „Ја намалува шансата за штетници за 60%.“ The sentence is understandable but reads as a literal rendering of English \"chance\".", "fix": "„Ја намалува веројатноста за штетници за 60%.“ (or „Го намалува ризикот од штетници за 60%.“)" }, { "title": "Strain name „Шар Планина Хаза“: „Хаза“ is not a valid rendering of \"Haze\", and the place name is not adjectivized", "severity": "low", "location": "{id:\"shar\", ime:\"Шар Планина Хаза\", cena:3200, ...}", "problem": "Two problems in one name. (1) „Хаза“ is not a Macedonian word and is not the transliteration of the cannabis term \"Haze\" — that would be „Хејз“. (2) All the other place-derived strains correctly use the adjectival form agreeing with the head noun („Пелистерска Магла“, „Охридски Кристал“, „Дојранска Ноќ“, „Скопско Зелено“); this one leaves the toponym in the bare nominative. The established Macedonian adjective from Шар Планина is „шарпланински“ (cf. шарпланинец).", "failure_scenario": "A level-8 player opens Продавница and sees „Шар Планина Хаза“ listed among four correctly-formed adjectival strain names; the label also appears on the plant tile via .znak-sorta, where it reads as a broken, unattributable word.", "fix": "Rename to „Шарпланински Хејз“ (adjective + correct transliteration) or, to stay in the fog/night imagery of the other strains, „Шарпланинска Магла“." }, { "title": "Imperative with a missing definite object: „Заврши сушење“", "severity": "low", "location": "", "problem": "Macedonian transitive imperatives with a specific, already-introduced object take the definite form (and usually a doubling clitic): „Заврши го сушењето“. Bare „Заврши сушење“ is telegraphic and ungrammatical for a specific batch already visible on the card. The same bare form is repeated in the empty-warehouse hint.", "failure_scenario": "Player opens Сушара with a batch in progress; the action button reads „Заврши сушење“. Switching to Магацин while empty shows „Заврши сушење за да добиеш производ.“ — both read as clipped headline-style text rather than an instruction.", "fix": "Use „Заврши го сушењето“ on the button and „Заврши го сушењето за да добиеш производ.“ in the empty-warehouse message." } ]
